Dialogs.Dialog: Hiya, sorry to keep you waiting♪
Long time no see... or not, maybe.
Nice to meet you, I'm Manaka Takane. Pleased to meet you.
I'm Manaka Takane. Let's be friends.
I'm Manaka Takane, nice to meet you.
Ah, I have a feeling I'll hear some good stories today.
Nice to see you again today.
Something on your mind？ You can tell me anything.
Nice to meet you. Between us girls, let's talk about anything.
This is our first time meeting... but let's talk lots and become friends？
Even if it's our first time, let's not hold back with each other.
What should I talk about first...
It's a little embarrassing... but maybe I'll say it.
Is it okay... if I gush about him a little？
Now, what should I talk about first♪
What should I talk about today...
I hope we have a nice time.
Yes, I'm looking forward to it.
Sorry, I need to change my mood...
I shouldn't have such a gloomy face. Let me pull myself together...
Yes, a little... I'll tell you later.
There's something I want to talk about...
I see... in my case... yeah.
So it really is like that？
So you worry about that kind of thing too.
I have something to ask that's a secret from my boyfriend.
I'd like to hear your opinion on something, is that okay？
I'll listen, if I'm good enough？
...I don't think I can agree, maybe.
I see. I'd like to use that as a reference.
I see... that's one way to look at it.
Thank you. I'm glad I asked♪
I can't say something like that.
Was that... a bit too bold？
I see. It took courage to ask, too...
Hehe, did I go too far？
Then next, it's my turn to ask.
Um, can I ask something too？
Right, I'd like to hear your story too.
Huh, is it embarrassing？ Then I won't say it.
Huh, that's no good either？ I don't know what I can talk about anymore...
Are things going well with your boyfriend？
Lately I've been leaning on him a lot again. Since we started dating, I think... I've changed♪
I want to stay stuck to him forever. Just recently we were all lovey-dovey too... I've been completely dyed in his colors▼
Every time I see his face, I love him so much I can't stand it... even lately▼ Even I'm surprised I've become like this.
When I'm with him, I can't keep my own pace. I just go all melty... he's influencing me way too much... Just kidding▼
Things are going really well▼ It's true that love changes people. I'm kind of looking forward to seeing who I'll become... Just kidding▼
We're so lovey-dovey, geez▼ I tell myself to hold back, but once I see him, it's hopeless▼
We had a little fight. I want to make up, but I'm being stubborn somehow.
Things are a little awkward right now... if only I could be more honest...
We're in the middle of a fight. I want it to be over soon, but I can't find a good chance.
I'm sure he's sorry too... it'll be okay.
Maybe it's good to wait and see for a bit. I think it'll feel cleaner than making up halfway.
Physical closeness with your boyfriend is important, right？ What about you？
If you're dating, I think there's some physical affection... is it going well？
When you kiss your boyfriend... um, do you think it... feels good？
It's like he can read everything I want him to do... geez.
My boyfriend is... probably fine, I think. I'm not sure if that's an answer.
That... I wouldn't know about that.
Actually, not really... I don't think so, maybe.
Um... is it shameless for the girl to make the first move？
My boyfriend doesn't kiss me much... What should I do？
How have your dates been lately？
We often go on dates on the way home from school. Taking all sorts of detours is fun♪
Nothing particularly special... but it's not like I'm unhappy.
He gave me a precious memory. I'll never forget that date...
Recently I went over to his place. We felt closer than usual, and the mood was really nice...
The other day we spent time together in my room. We just relaxed together.
Weekday dates are nice, but you can't really take your time, can you？
Don't you think a date at his place is nice too？
When there's a special event, you want to go, right？
That's nice too, but don't you ever want a special memory？
I think after-school dates are fun too.
Haven't you ever thought you'd like to spend time relaxing at his place, not just going out on dates？
You want both, right？ Special dates, and regular dates where you can be yourself.
How nice. I want to make memories like that with my boyfriend too▼
Since it's a date, don't you want to go out？
I see. Then you'll want to invite him to your room too.
Then, will your next date be at his place？
Wow, how bold！ Inviting him to your room... that's heart-pounding, isn't it？
Have you ever wished he'd pull you back when you're leaving a date？ And just stay like that, forever... Just kidding.
Right. I think my boyfriend probably feels the same way.
Really？ I don't really think so...
Yes, I've thought that... if it really happened...
Yes... but just imagining it makes my face go red.
Sorry, I don't really get it. Maybe it's too early for me.
Hey... do you make home-cooked meals for your boyfriend？
Can you tell me about the food you make for your boyfriend？
Do you often go to his place early in the morning to make breakfast？
I often make dinner at his place, I think.
When we study together at home, I have him try my homemade sweets.
When we go on a special date, I put extra effort into a special homemade meal too.
Right. I often make Japanese food, I think.
I guess I end up making Western food a lot？
Hmm, at my place... I often make Chinese food.
I have fun planning all kinds of dishes. While thinking about what he likes.
I'm interested in regional dishes from all over, so I've been studying lots of them.
If you'd like, I can teach you my specialty？ Follow the recipe and the taste is guaranteed, hehe♪
Speaking of which, a dish I made recently was a big hit with my boyfriend. Give it a try if you'd like.
I'm so happy！ Thank you, I'll try making it right away.
Thank you, that's so kind. My boyfriend will be happy too.
Thank you, that helps a lot. I'll do my best making it.
There's a dish I just can't get right... how can I make it taste good？
I want to make it taste the way my boyfriend likes... but it's hard.
My cooking repertoire is so small... I really want to make him more kinds of things.
For example... how about changing the seasonings？ That changes it a lot.
Anyway, if you try all kinds of dishes, your repertoire will grow and you'll improve.
Maybe cooking is about repetition too. How about trying it again and again？
How about switching to seasonings your boyfriend likes？
Isn't it best to ask your boyfriend's opinion？ You might discover something new？
If you'd like, I'll teach you one from my repertoire？ There's a dish I recommend.
Then I'll teach you a dish I'm good at. Give it a try.
What about eating out on dates？
When you're on a date, you eat together, right？ I think that's pretty important...
We don't really eat much on our dates...
My boyfriend often takes me out to eat. Food tastes better with the person you love, doesn't it▼
Actually... the places my boyfriend picks aren't really my taste.
He always takes me to delicious places. It seems our tastes in food match perfectly♪
My boyfriend seems like the type who focuses on his food. We just eat together, I guess.
We're lovey-dovey even while eating. Feeding each other... hehe.
We have a regular spot for eating. It seems to be his favorite place.
He takes me to all sorts of places, it's fun.
My boyfriend's a real foodie. I think he's been to every notable restaurant in town？
It seems my boyfriend and I have different tastes in food...
You want to keep your memories in physical form, right？ Do you take pictures often？
Do you take pictures on your dates？
When your boyfriend points a camera at you... what do you do？ Give him a little fan service... Just kidding.
If your boyfriend asks, "Let me take a picture," how far should you let him go？ Like, um... daring ones.
My boyfriend doesn't take many pictures. Maybe he doesn't like cameras.
He takes pictures of me a lot. Because I want to be able to look back on our memories anytime.
My boyfriend is my personal photographer. He's still in training, though...
He takes lots of pictures. I love his photos.
He takes pictures of me a lot. But... sometimes it's a little troubling.
Lately my boyfriend's really into cameras. He's collecting all kinds of parts... such a boy thing.
My boyfriend is great at taking pictures, he even won a prize in a contest！
I'm curious how the pictures will turn out, so I try to go along with it as much as I can.
If he'll make me look pretty, maybe a little is okay...
I think when you don't like something, you need to say no...
Photos last forever... so I think it's important to firmly say no.
Lately my boyfriend's been trying to take weird pictures... Should I tell him off？
That necklace is lovely, isn't it？
That ring looks great on you.
That hairstyle is perfect for you.
Lovely clothes. I envy your fashion sense.
Really？ I'm so happy... this was a present from my boyfriend.
I'm glad. I took the plunge and changed my hair color, so I guess it worked？
When there's someone who's happy about it, you want to be even more stylish, right♪
Fashion is fun because everyone has their own opinion. I'd like to swap tips again.
Um. We're not... at the point where I can talk about that yet.
I want to experience more things together. With him, I feel like I can discover a new me.
If I said it, you might think it's weird. My head is full of things I want to do with him▼
I think about it a lot, but in the end I stop thinking. Because no matter what happens, I'll follow him...▼
I'll never leave him, and I'm sure he won't either... So no matter how I think about it, we'll be together forever. Hehe▼
I'm hoping it stays like this forever... Because right now, I'm having the happiest time of my life...▼
Of course, with him all the way to heaven▼ And even if we're reborn, we'll meet again and be together... Just kidding▼
That was really lively this time♪
I learned a lot. I have to work hard too.
It was so fun I ended up talking too much.
Well then, I guess that's it for this time.
If we talk too much, our boyfriends might get mad at us. Hehe, see you.
It's already this late. We talked so much we lost track of time. See you.
Thank you for keeping me company so late. Good night.
That was fun... well, see you.
See you next time. I'm counting on you then.
